cg_roof.method: r1 masks (beige R-B > 22, R > 150, G-B > 8; lobes 3.5-m mean > 228, s.d. < 5) blurred (1.2 / 3.0 px) and contoured at 0.5 on a 4x grid, simplified 0.12 / 0.25 m; rim colour = median of the beige pixels 1 px inside the mask
